import glob, pathlib, shutil
for src in sorted(glob.glob('runs/e16-base-skywork/e16-skywork/base/shard_*/records.jsonl')):
    path = pathlib.Path(src)
    dst = pathlib.Path('/kaggle/working/e16-skywork/base') / path.parent.name / path.name
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy(src, dst)
    print('restored', dst, sum(1 for _ in open(dst)), 'records')
